<<CLEANING A TELESCOPE MIRROR, BRIEFLY>>

TO CLEAN A TELESCOPE MIRROR, FIRST REMOVE ANY DEBRIS FROM THE SURFACE. USE A CLEAN, DRY TOWEL TO WIPED THE MIRROR. MAKE SURE THE MIRROR IS COOL AND DRY BEFORE CLEANING. USE A SOFT, CLEAN TOWEL TO GENTLY WIPED THE MIRROR. DO NOT USE ANY CHEMICAL CLEANERS OR WET TOWELS. CLEAN THE MIRROR IN A DRY PLACE TO PREVENT STAINING. AFTER CLEANING, LET THE MIRROR AIR DRY COMPLETELY BEFORE USING. CHECK THE MIRROR FOR ANY DAMAGE OR IRREGULARITIES. CLEAN THE MIRROR EVERY 6 TO 12 MONTHS TO MAINTAIN OPTIMAL PERFORMANCE. ALWAYS USE A CLEAN TOWEL TO CLEAN THE MIRROR TO PREVENT DAMAGE.
